notes.title: Major Update: Endless Mode
notes.content:
Dear freddy Fans, 
We've finally Released a new endless mode for you, 
Join the colosseum and fight off unlimited waves of enemies,
Purchase new tools and rewards, and upgrade your weapons, 
fight off new enemies and bosses

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Major Update for I Love You Freddy
notes.content:
Hello Freddy Fans! We've released a big update for you!

We now have 3 new in game weapons, Each hidden and has unique abilities, you will find them hidden in the games area, some more hidden than others. As you would expect, they are wonderfully absurd weapons, we hope you enjoy them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752511/570977735133d8bb193f3f8918a3e5f136a52aad.png[/img]

Other than that, we've also done some minor updates with it:

- Optimized the game further
- fixed joystick functionality where pressing start didn't work

notes.title: minor update for 22 December 2023
notes.content:
minor update:

- fixed ending where chase would continue endlessly
- removed slow down effect after hitting
- fixed obstacle shortcut in the clinic
- fix Tina chasing after the player even when standing on a fence
- fixed romance room where tina was able to enter

notes.title: update for 21st of december, 2023
notes.content:
Dear Freddy fans, we've updated the game as per requests

- more optimizations for smoother gameplay
- added an expandable map for more guidance

we are working on more updates, and also a special surprise coming soon.
Thank you.

notes.title: update notes for december 18th
notes.content:
Dear Freddy Fans, 
we've updated the game to give you a smoother experience

- Fixed Maze difficulty by adding some guidance
- added fence around the docks
- added signs on the rooms to indicate which room it is
- fixed tina chasing you even though you're on crates

more updates are on the way!
